title: Phone Rule #1: give the phone a home
cta: Free 5-Minute Homework Start Kit · link in bio

copy.caption: Give the phone a home. Pick a spot together, use the same spot every night, and let parents' phones go there too. The same rule for everyone is easier to keep. Free 5-Minute Homework Start Kit: link in bio.
